composing_units: 39th Infantry Regiment; 47th Infantry Regiment; 60th Infantry Regiment
notes: Landing at Utah began ~10 June (39th Infantry landed 11 June and committed 12 June on the coast).

current_activity: taking over westward attack toward Saint-Sauveur-le-Vicomte
notes: Took over main westward attack with 82nd Airborne on 14 June (Maj. Gen. Manton Eddy); bridgehead at Sainte-Colombe/Saint-Sauveur.
3rd Bn 60th Infantry reached Barneville-sur-Mer early 18 June; 47th cut the La Haye-du-Puits road at Grande Huanville late 17 June; isolated Cherbourg garrison; 77th Div column destroyed.
47th Infantry fighting in the south-west suburbs 25 June; 39th/47th at Octeville and Equeurdreville.

current_activity: attacking up Cap de la Hague
notes: 9th Division, relieved of Cherbourg duties, attacked up Cap de la Hague on 29 June (47th on north coast, 60th in centre, 4th Cavalry Group on left).
